events.description: Spun out of full-sweep audit of docs/Design/Complete.md on 2026-05-19 (C1 + C5-partial + C7 + H11). Was originally proposed as task-age-up-transformations-066 in task-065's Out-of-Scope section.

events.title: Remove self-destruct + add culture switch
events.description: AgeUpSystem: StartGathererHutSelfDestruct + StartHutSelfDestruct deleted. Per-culture dispatch stubs (TransformGathererHutsForCulture, TransformHutsForCulture) added to be filled in by Phase 2/3. Runai branch keeps RunaiPopOverride. No hut is destroyed by age-up anymore.

events.title: Feraldis persistence + House -> Raider auto-spawn
events.description: BuildingConstructionSystem.CompleteConstruction spawns 1 Feraldis Raider when a HutTag building owned by a Feraldis-cultured faction finishes construction (L1). BuildingUpgradeSystem.OnUpdate spawns count==TargetLevel raiders on upgrade ticks (2 at L2, 3 at L3). Helpers use the same fan-out offset so raiders don't stack. Depends on task-067 FeraldisRaider unit (now landed).

Phase 2 (Alanthor wall-anchor + Runai wagon-burst) deferred: requires design decisions not in the doc (wall ring radius/segment count, wagon stat block, decay curve shape, what 'unpack at Trade Post site' looks like UX-side). Recommend pairing with task-069 (Runai Trade Post split) and a design pass for the Alanthor wall-ring rules before implementation.
